summary: IEEE-oriented graphical reference for motor overload trip nc contact, with public vendor evidence and drawing-reading notes.
description: The overload NC contact form is an auxiliary connection linked to the motor overload device. It is read in the control circuit, while overload-sensing elements remain in the motor power path or their documented measurement circuit.

This is a convention-specific lookup based on the publisher's IEEE-labelled preview. The geometry here is independently drawn to explain the connection or operation; it is not a certified reproduction of the standard graphic.
readingNotes: Link the auxiliary contact to the overload element's tag.
Read the selected library and the project legend together. A vendor block identifier is meaningful within its named library and is not a universal standard-symbol code.
distinction: The overload auxiliary contact does not itself represent the motor's full-current power path.
